recommendation: Keep the audit as-is. Do not re-add interpolated for FHIR-36648 unless the Imaging Integration work group reopens or supersedes FHIR-45266.
issue_request: FHIR-36648 was Published with resolution Not Persuasive with Modification. It reported that the old ImagingSelection graphic type required binding lacked DICOM CIRCLE and INTERPOLATED values, and asked either to add the missing values or relax the binding to extensible. The final resolution pointed to the Imaging Integration Confluence change set.
initial_application: The change was implemented by the ImagingSelection update work merged as 471fbc468b8fd5427fcebad076569e16590ac707, with source commit 5c5a620527e102650cad53df57ff594d1706fe2a splitting the old generic graphic type into separate 2D and 3D code systems/value sets and adding CIRCLE and INTERPOLATED to the 2D set while retaining a required binding.
additional_context: ImagingSelection remains active in source/fhir.ini. Later Applied FHIR-45266 intentionally replaced interpolated with multipoint to align the 2D graphic type value set with DICOM SCOORD, and FHIR-55241 later added unknown as the required-binding escape valve and corrected the DICOM reference. Existing combined-branch audits already represent FHIR-36649, FHIR-45266, and FHIR-55241.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Re-adding interpolated would conflict with the later Applied FHIR-45266 decision, and changing the binding to extensible would conflict with the FHIR-36648 Confluence resolution and later escape-valve handling.
